statusBar.git: Status bar item that opens the Git panel. Git is a product name.
statusBar.detached: Git term: HEAD is not on a branch. Keep HEAD.
statusBar.tray: Accessible name of the status bar group that lists tool windows (Mock server, Capture proxy, Run, Load test, Monitors, Negative tests) that are open, minimized or running in the background.
statusBar.showTool: Tooltip of a tool window entry in the status bar. {{name}} is the tool's name, such as Mock server.
statusBar.port: Port a mock server listens on, shown after a colon, as in :4010.
statusBar.held: Number of captured requests held for the user to forward or drop.
statusBar.progress: Requests finished out of planned in a collection run, as in 7 of 12.
statusBar.failingMonitors: Number of monitors whose last check failed.
statusBar.findings: Number of problems that negative tests found in the API.
statusBar.toolFinished: Notice shown when a minimized tool finishes. {{name}} is the tool's name, {{detail}} its result, such as 7 of 12 or 340 requests.
statusBar.liveCount: Status bar entry counting open WebSocket and SSE connections and running flows.
statusBar.liveFlow: Kind of a live activity: a flow (a scripted sequence of requests) that is running.
statusBar.holdingNotice: Notice shown when the hidden Capture proxy holds requests until the user forwards or drops them. {{name}} is the tool name.
